title: Cognizant × AMF1 Singapore STEM Lab
subtitle: Hands-on data analytics & race telemetry workshop for Singapore students
description: Hosted in Singapore leading up to the 2026 Marina Bay GP, this initiative pairs Cognizant data scientists and AMF1 race engineers with secondary and polytechnic students to code real-time telemetry models, analyze tire deg, and explore digital engineering careers.

title: Global SAF Flyaway Logistics Corridor
subtitle: Decarbonizing Singapore transcontinental air freight via certified SAFc
description: Aston Martin Aramco deploys Sustainable Aviation Fuel certificates (SAFc) across flyaway air freight with DHL Global Forwarding, directly abating long-haul charter flight lifecycle emissions by over 80%.

title: ADHD Foundation Umbrella Project & ERG
subtitle: Celebrating neurodiversity and invisible disability across the workforce
description: A campus-wide cultural activation displaying 32 multicoloured umbrellas to champion the 1 in 5 people who think differently, backed by the 35-colleague internal Neurodiversity Employee Resource Group.

title: Wild Meadow & Onsite Apiary
subtitle: 72,000 m² wildflower habitat and onsite beekeeping for nature net gain
description: Restoring biodiversity around the Silverstone Technology Campus with 72,000 m² of wild meadow and onsite beehives delivering +122% biodiversity net gain and over 100 jars of honey harvested annually.

title: Aleto Foundation Motorsport Leadership
subtitle: Empowering young ethnic minority leaders through executive mentoring
description: Now in its 3rd consecutive cycle, this program pairs emerging leaders from underrepresented backgrounds with AMF1 executive leadership to break down systemic barriers in high performance racing.
